prose: Zalando's incubator open-sourced the Agentic Identity Broker, an MIT-licensed OAuth2 broker that lets a user give an AI agent scoped, revocable access to MCP services without handing over credentials. It manages delegation chains for on-behalf-of flows, bridges OAuth2 systems, provides a token vault, consent management and audit logging, and sits in the call path via gateways. It saves each MCP server from running its own OAuth2 ceremony.
highlights: Scoped, revocable delegation for agents to MCP services
Token vault, consent UI and audit logs
Offloads OAuth work from agent and server authors
